cohort: The cohort consisted of 114 women who experienced a stillbirth, with an average maternal age of 32.19 years and an average gestational age of 32 weeks.
finding: Maternal pathologies, primarily hypertension, were the most frequent identified cause of stillbirths (28.07%), followed by placental (22%) and cord abnormalities (21.05%), with 20.17% remaining unexplained using the CODAC classification.
cross-section timing: Data collected retrospectively over a 5-year period
